blocks.text: Kenya is rushing to contain Ebola cases linked to the deadliest outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The East African nation has reported two cases and one death. The DRC has reported more than 9,000 cases and 4,400 deaths. Kenya’s first Ebola patient died at Nairobi hospital on October 5.
